decoy-01.x3d.intent: A light switch: each click on the plate flips the lamp. The first click turns it on, the next click turns it off, and so on.
decoy-01.x3d.why_suspicious: TouchSensor.isActive (TRUE on press, FALSE on release) is routed straight into a toggle, which looks like a double flip per click; and the ROUTE reads 'toggle_changed' although the field is called 'toggle'. Both are fine: BooleanToggle ignores FALSE inputs, and toggle is inputOutput so the _changed form is allowed.
decoy-01.x3d.witness_note: Lamp.on after real clicks 1, 2, 3: true, false, true. Console errors: 0.

decoy-02.x3d.intent: A globe that spins steadily about its vertical axis, one full turn every four seconds.
decoy-02.x3d.why_suspicious: The keyValue runs from angle 0 to angle 6.2832 about one axis, the classic 'does not rotate' trap; but there are four keys 120 degrees apart, so every segment is less than half a turn and the shortest path is the intended direction.
decoy-02.x3d.witness_note: Globe turn about +Y tracks 2*pi*fraction (worst deviation 0 rad, sampling skew included); folded angle max 3.113 over 4.2 s. Console errors: 0.

decoy-03.x3d.intent: A buoy that bobs up and down every three seconds, from the moment the scene loads and for as long as it stays open.
decoy-03.x3d.why_suspicious: startTime='1' and stopTime='0' look like a clock that is stopped before it starts, and like times that are long past. A stopTime not later than startTime is ignored, and a looping sensor whose startTime is in the past simply runs.
decoy-03.x3d.witness_note: Buoy.translation.y max 0.98 over 3.4 s; clock still active at the end: true. Console errors: 0.

decoy-04.x3d.intent: A slider block that swings left and right, two metres each way, once every four seconds, moved by a script that writes its position directly.
decoy-04.x3d.why_suspicious: Nothing is routed out of the Script and nothing is routed into the Transform, so it looks unconnected. The Script holds the Transform in an SFNode field (USE) and writes its translation directly, which is allowed because directOutput='true'.
decoy-04.x3d.witness_note: Slider.translation.x min -1.998 max 2 over 4.2 s. Console errors: 0.

decoy-05.x3d.intent: A leader cube that hops between two spots every second, staying put between hops, and a ball that copies the leader's position exactly, one metre higher.
decoy-05.x3d.why_suspicious: ROUTE statements sit inside Transform nodes instead of at the end of the Scene; a key value is repeated (0.5 0.5), a Transform is routed straight to another Transform with no interpolator, one ROUTE writes 'translation' without set_, and sensors and interpolators are children of a Transform. All legal: ROUTE may appear wherever a child node may, keys need only be non-decreasing (a repeated key makes a step), and inputOutput fields can be routed from and to under either name.
decoy-05.x3d.witness_note: Leader.translation.x values seen: -1.5 1.5; Copy.translation.x equal to it in every sample: true. Console errors: 0.

fault-01.x3d.fault: The size animation uses a ScalarInterpolator, so an SFFloat value_changed is routed to Transform.set_scale, which is SFVec3f.
fault-01.x3d.spec: error per the X3D standard (ISO/IEC 19775-1 4.4.8.1 Routes: source and destination fields of a ROUTE shall have the same type)
fault-01.x3d.witness_note: PulsingBall.scale.x max 1 over 2.6 s. X_ITE console warning: XML Parser: Bad ROUTE specification: source field type must match destination field type of fields named "value_changed" and "scale". Twin: PulsingBall.scale.x max 1.496 over 2.6 s.

fault-02.x3d.fault: The grow animation is routed to Box.size, an initializeOnly field that cannot receive events, instead of to the enclosing Transform's scale.
fault-02.x3d.spec: error per the X3D standard (ISO/IEC 19775-1 4.4.2.2 and 4.4.8.1: a ROUTE destination shall be an inputOnly or inputOutput field; Box.size is initializeOnly)
fault-02.x3d.viewer_sees: The crate stays a small cube.
fault-02.x3d.witness_note: max of Crate.scale.y / CrateBox.size.y 1 over 3.2 s. X_ITE console warning: XML Parser: Bad ROUTE specification: destination field "size" must be an input. Twin: max of Crate.scale.y / CrateBox.size.y 3.584 over 3.2 s.

fault-03.x3d.fault: The TimeSensor that should run forever has no loop='true'; with the default startTime of 0 and loop FALSE it never becomes active.
fault-03.x3d.witness_note: Blades.rotation.angle max 0 over 2.5 s, clock isActive seen false. Twin: Blades.rotation.angle max 3.202 over 2.5 s, clock isActive seen true.

fault-04.x3d.fault: cycleInterval is written in milliseconds (500) although the field is in seconds, so one flash takes 500 s instead of 0.5 s.
fault-04.x3d.viewer_sees: The beacon looks frozen at whatever brightness it had on load; it drifts imperceptibly.
fault-04.x3d.witness_note: BeaconMaterial.emissiveColor.r swing (max minus min) 0.008 over 2 s. Twin: BeaconMaterial.emissiveColor.r swing (max minus min) 0.98 over 2 s.

fault-05.x3d.fault: The PositionInterpolator has four keys but only three keyValues; the second 'top' position that makes the platform wait is missing.
fault-05.x3d.spec: error per the X3D standard (ISO/IEC 19775-1 19.4.6 PositionInterpolator / 19.3.1 X3DInterpolatorNode: keyValue shall contain exactly as many values as key)
fault-05.x3d.viewer_sees: The platform does not wait at the top (in X_ITE it starts sinking the moment it arrives and then sits at the bottom); other players may do something else, since the result is undefined.
fault-05.x3d.witness_note: Platform.translation.y while clock fraction in 0.43..0.57: min 0.559 max 2.261 (8 samples). Twin: Platform.translation.y while clock fraction in 0.43..0.57: min 3 max 3 (9 samples).

fault-06.x3d.fault: The full turn is given as two keys, angle 0 and angle 6.2832 about the same axis; these are the same orientation, and an OrientationInterpolator takes the shortest path between them, which is no motion.
fault-06.x3d.viewer_sees: The globe does not spin at all.
fault-06.x3d.witness_note: Globe.rotation angle (folded to 0..pi) max 0 over 2.5 s. Twin: Globe.rotation angle (folded to 0..pi) max 3.11 over 2.5 s.

fault-07.x3d.fault: Both TimeSensors carry the same DEF name (copy-paste); the ROUTEs at the end both resolve to one of them, so both lanterns share one clock.
fault-07.x3d.spec: error per the X3D standard (ISO/IEC 19775-1 4.4.3 DEF/USE semantics and 19776-1 XML encoding: DEF is of type ID and shall be unique in the document)
fault-07.x3d.viewer_sees: Both lanterns bob in perfect step on one shared clock; the left lantern's two-second rhythm is gone.
fault-07.x3d.witness_note: max |left.y - right.y| 0; left y range 0.967, right y range 0.967 over 3.2 s. Twin: max |left.y - right.y| 0.663; left y range 0.982, right y range 0.985 over 3.2 s.

fault-08.x3d.fault: The first ROUTE names fromNode='DoorTimer', but no node has that DEF; the clock is called DoorClock.
fault-08.x3d.spec: error per the X3D standard (ISO/IEC 19775-1 4.4.8.1 Routes and the 19776-1 XML encoding ROUTE statement: fromNode shall be the DEF name of a node defined earlier in the scene)
fault-08.x3d.witness_note: Door.translation.x max 0 over 5.3 s. X_ITE console warning: XML Parser: Unknown named or imported node 'DoorTimer'. Twin: Door.translation.x max 1.979 over 5.3 s.

fault-09.x3d.fault: The scene declares profile Immersive only, but uses a ColorChaser, which belongs to the Followers component that Immersive does not include; the component statement is missing.
fault-09.x3d.spec: error per the X3D standard (ISO/IEC 19775-1 7.2.5.3-7.2.5.4 PROFILE and COMPONENT statements, and Annex on Immersive profile: a scene shall use only nodes supported by its declared profile and components; Followers level 1 is not in Immersive)
fault-09.x3d.viewer_sees: A strictly conforming Immersive player may refuse the node, leaving the panel blue for ever; X_ITE only warns and plays it.
fault-09.x3d.witness_note: PanelMaterial.diffuseColor.r max 1 over 3 s. X_ITE console warning: Node type 'ColorChaser' does not match component/profile statements in 'fault-09.x3d'. Twin: PanelMaterial.diffuseColor.r max 1 over 3 s.

fault-10.x3d.fault: The first ROUTE uses fromField='fraction'; TimeSensor has no such field, the output is fraction_changed.
fault-10.x3d.spec: error per the X3D standard (ISO/IEC 19775-1 4.4.8.1 Routes: the ROUTE shall name an existing output field of the source node; 8.4.1 TimeSensor has fraction_changed)
fault-10.x3d.witness_note: BridgeDeck.rotation.angle max 0 over 6.3 s. X_ITE console warning: XML Parser: Unknown field 'fraction' in node class TimeSensor. Twin: BridgeDeck.rotation.angle max 1.044 over 6.3 s.

fault-12.x3d.fault: The TouchSensor sits among the floor's children instead of beside the button's geometry, so it senses the floor and not the button.

fault-17.x3d.fault: TouchSensor.isActive sends TRUE on press and FALSE on release, and the script flips its state on every event without looking at the value, so each click flips the lamp twice.

fault-18.x3d.fault: Both PositionInterpolators are routed to the same inner Transform's translation in the same timestamp, so one overwrites the other; the crossing should drive the outer BeePath Transform.
